questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "freeing up room" mean?
options: Increasing the amount of money a bank can lend or pay dividends
Creating physical space in the bank's office
questions.explain_en: It means the banks have more capacity to lend money or pay dividends because the IRB approach lowers the capital they must hold.

A new tax on bank dividends
The approval results for domestic banks using the IRB approach
That all banks must adopt the IRB approach immediately

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "compound annual rate" mean?
options: The total growth over the whole period divided by the number of years
The yearly growth rate that is added each year without considering previous growth
The average yearly growth rate that includes the effect of previous years' growth
A rate that only applies to the first year of the period
questions.explain_en: A compound annual rate means the growth each year builds on the previous year's growth, so the rate is applied to the accumulated amount.
questions.explain_zh: 「compound annual rate」指的是每年的成長會累積到前一年的金額上，形成複利式的年增率。
